# Twenty public pages and the one control a step would have to find on each.
# Format: url<TAB>role[|role…]<TAB>name-substring (case-insensitive; an empty
# substring means "any control of that role"). Alternative roles are listed
# where a site is free to call the same control a combobox or a textbox.
#
# Nothing here is logged in to and nothing is typed: the tool loads the page,
# observes once, and looks for the control in the candidate list.

# Search boxes — the case jev-browser had to leave the a11y tree for.
https://duckduckgo.com/	combobox|searchbox|textbox	search
https://www.bing.com/	combobox|searchbox|textbox	search
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Main_Page	searchbox|combobox|textbox	search

# Google Flights — the owner's task; three fields on one page.
https://www.google.com/travel/flights	combobox|textbox	where from
https://www.google.com/travel/flights	combobox|textbox	where to
https://www.google.com/travel/flights	textbox|combobox|button	departure

# A login form (the username field only; no credentials are ever typed).
https://github.com/login	textbox	username

# Cookie-consent banners.
https://www.theguardian.com/international	link	news
https://www.nytimes.com/	link	world

# E-commerce and newspaper search.
https://www.ebay.com/	combobox|searchbox|textbox	search
https://www.amazon.com/	combobox|searchbox|textbox	search
https://www.bbc.com/	button|link|searchbox|textbox	search bbc
https://www.reddit.com/	searchbox|combobox|textbox	search

# Pagination.
https://datatables.net/examples/basic_init/zero_configuration.html	link|button	next
https://news.ycombinator.com/	link	=more

# A select, a plain login form, a date picker, a contenteditable editor.
https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/dropdown	combobox|listbox	
https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/login	textbox	username
https://demoqa.com/date-picker	textbox	select date
https://www.booking.com/	button|textbox|combobox	check-in
https://quilljs.com/	textbox
